class.name: OcgAISAnimation
class.brief_description: Class represents a basic animation class. AIS_Animation can be used as:
class.description: ! Class represents a basic animation class. ! AIS_Animation can be used as: ! ! - Animation Implementor ! Sub-classes should override method AIS_Animation::update() to perform specific animation. ! AIS package provides limited number of such animation atoms - classes AIS_AnimationObject and ! AIS_AnimationCamera, which could be enough for defining a simple animation. In general case, ! application is expected defining own AIS_Animation sub-classes implementing ! application-specific animation logic (e.g. another interpolation or another kind of ! transformations - like color transition and others). The basic conception of ! AIS_Animation::update() is defining an exact scene state for the current presentation ! timestamp, providing a smooth and continuous animation well defined at any time step and in ! any direction. So that a time difference between two sequential drawn Viewer frames can vary ! from frame to frame without visual artifacts, increasing rendering framerate would not lead to ! animation being executed too fast and low framerate (on slow hardware) would not lead to ! animation played longer than defined duration. Hence, implementation should avoid usage of ! incremental step logic or should apply it very carefully. ! ! - Animation Container ! AIS_Animation (no sub-classing) can be used to aggregate a sequence of Animation items ! (children). Each children should be defined with its own duration and start time (presentation ! timestamp). It is possible defining collection of nested AIS_Animation items, so that within ! each container level children define start playback time relative to its holder. ! ! - Animation playback Controller ! It is suggested that application would define a single AIS_Animation instance (optional ! sub-classing) for controlling animation playback as whole. Such controller should be filled in ! by other AIS_Animation as children objects, and will be managed by application by calling ! StartTimer(), UpdateTimer() and IsStopped() methods. ! ! Note, that AIS_Animation::StartTimer() defines a timer calculating an elapsed time, not a ! multimedia timer executing Viewer updates at specific intervals! Application should avoid using ! implicit and immediate Viewer updates to ensure that AIS_Animation::UpdateTimer() is called ! before each redrawing of a Viewer content. Redrawing logic should be also managed at application ! level for managing a smooth animation (by defining a multimedia timer provided by used GUI ! framework executing updates at desired framerate, or as continuous redraws in loop).

method.name: StartPts
method.description: Returns start time of the animation in the timeline

method.name: SetStartPts
method.description: Sets time limits for animation in the animation timeline

method.name: Duration
method.description: Returns duration of the animation in the timeline

method.name: UpdateTotalDuration
method.description: Update total duration considering all animations on timeline.

method.name: HasOwnDuration
method.description: Return true if duration is defined.

method.name: OwnDuration
method.description: Returns own duration of the animation in the timeline

method.name: SetOwnDuration
method.description: Defines duration of the animation.

method.name: Add
method.description: Add single animation to the timeline.

method.name: Clear
method.description: Clear animation timeline - remove all animations from it.

method.name: Remove
method.description: Remove the child animation.

method.name: Replace
method.description: Replace the child animation.

method.name: CopyFrom
method.description: Clears own children and then copy child animations from another object. Copy also Start Time and Duration values.

method.name: StartTimer
method.description: Start animation with internally defined timer instance. Calls ::Start() internally.

method.name: UpdateTimer
method.description: Update single frame of animation, update timer state

method.name: ElapsedTime
method.description: Return elapsed time.

method.name: Timer
method.description: Return playback timer.

method.name: SetTimer
method.description: Set playback timer.

method.name: Start
method.description: Start animation. This method changes status of the animation to Started. This status defines whether animation is to be performed in the timeline or not.

method.name: Pause
method.description: Pause the process timeline.

method.name: Stop
method.description: Stop animation. This method changed status of the animation to Stopped. This status shows that animation will not be performed in the timeline or it is finished.

method.name: IsStopped
method.description: Check if animation is to be performed in the animation timeline.

method.name: Update
method.description: Update single frame of animation, update timer state
